familyAndFriend.title: Family and Friends
familyAndFriend.description: Family and Friends is Oxford's best-selling basic English teaching course of all time, helping millions of students worldwide succeed with English. The program includes new sections introducing functional language used daily so students can build conversations from the start. These are often practical projects, fun craft activities that encourage participants to practice speaking skills. Students can practice interacting with each other using grammar structures, vocabulary, and all 4 skills. Family and Friends - 2nd edition includes content to enhance English fluency practice with DVD support, online interactive practice, updated assessment and competency testing materials, and supplementary sections focusing on culture

examPreparation.description: This is a new exam preparation set following the new TOEIC® test structure, including detailed test strategies and skills for candidates to improve scores for each test section, over 1000 practice exercises, 2 competency tests on TOEIC® Listening and Reading skills, 2 complete tests with TOEIC®-style answer sheets for candidates to evaluate and prepare for TOEIC® test conditions, 1 Audio CD included with the book containing the Listening section, 1 Complete Audio Program (not sold with the book, includes listening in all sections), an audio script including all materials recorded in the Complete Audio Program.
